kbArticles.title: No POST on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: System does not start at all — no beeps, no LEDs, no display
Confirmed power adapter SP-CHG-65W is functional
kbArticles.cause: SP-MB-15X motherboard failure or critical hardware fault preventing POST (Power-On Self Test).
resolution: Perform hard reset: disconnect SP-CHG-65W and SP-BATT-15X, hold power 30 seconds
Remove all external accessories and retry
Reseat SP-RAM-16-DDR5 module
Attempt boot with single RAM stick
If still no POST, motherboard replacement (SP-MB-15X) may be required
Escalate to Tier 2 with full documentation before ordering SP-MB-15X

kbArticles.title: BIOS Corrupted on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: System boots to black screen with no BIOS
LED blink code indicates BIOS fault
kbArticles.cause: Incomplete or failed BIOS flash corrupted the SP-MB-15X BIOS chip firmware.
resolution: Attempt BIOS recovery via USB recovery key (download recovery image from support portal)
Insert recovery USB and power on while holding Fn+B or model-specific recovery keys
If USB recovery fails, BIOS chip reflash requires service center
In extreme cases, SP-MB-15X replacement is required
Order SP-MB-15X from WH-SJO-002 if recovery fails

kbArticles.title: Motherboard Replacement Procedure for AeroVolt ProBook 15X
kbArticles.cause: Motherboard hardware failure requiring SP-MB-15X full board replacement.
resolution: Order SP-MB-15X from WH-SJO-002 (San Jose Spare Parts & Warranty Depot) with correct platform configuration
Backup customer data if possible before service
Technician: remove all components — battery SP-BATT-15X, SSD SP-SSD-1TB-NVME, RAM SP-RAM-16-DDR5
Disconnect all cables from old board
Install new SP-MB-15X and reconnect all components
Reassemble and test POST, then run full diagnostics
Update BIOS and EC firmware on new board

kbArticles.title: POST Beep Code Diagnostics on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: System emits beep codes during startup
kbArticles.cause: POST beep codes indicate hardware fault detected by SP-MB-15X BIOS during power-on self-test.
resolution: 1 beep: Normal POST, no error
3 beeps: Memory (RAM) failure — reseat or replace SP-RAM-16-DDR5
5 beeps: CPU failure — escalate to Tier 2
6 beeps: Keyboard controller — check SP-KBD-15X
8 beeps: Display/GPU failure — check SP-DISP-15X-FHD
Document beep pattern and escalate if not resolvable by component swap

kbArticles.title: USB Ports Not Working on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: USB hub on AeroVolt Nexus Docking Station also not working
kbArticles.cause: USB controller on SP-MB-15X failed or USB driver corruption.
resolution: Reinstall USB/chipset drivers
Check Device Manager for USB controller errors
Test in BIOS — if USB devices not recognized there, hardware fault confirmed
Update BIOS for USB controller fixes
If hardware USB controller fault confirmed, SP-MB-15X replacement required

kbArticles.title: BIOS Settings Lost After Shutdown on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Time and date reset to default after every shutdown
BIOS settings lost on power cycle
System prompts to set date/time on every boot
kbArticles.cause: CMOS battery on SP-MB-15X has failed. CMOS battery maintains RTC and BIOS settings when main power is off.
resolution: Confirm BIOS settings reset is consistent
CMOS battery replacement requires SP-MB-15X service (battery is soldered on this platform)
Workaround: set date/time via OS sync if NTP available
For permanent fix, escalate for SP-MB-15X CMOS battery replacement service
Schedule service if under warranty

kbArticles.title: POST Error Code 0xA1 on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: POST error code 0xA1 displayed on screen
kbArticles.cause: Error code 0xA1 indicates NVMe SSD not detected during POST — SP-SSD-1TB-NVME not responding.
resolution: Reseat SP-SSD-1TB-NVME in M.2 slot
Test with alternate SP-SSD-1TB-NVME to confirm SSD vs slot issue
Update BIOS for NVMe compatibility
If SSD is not detected after reseating, replace SP-SSD-1TB-NVME
If slot is faulty, SP-MB-15X replacement needed

kbArticles.title: Integrated Graphics Not Working on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Display output only works via external GPU
Integrated graphics missing in Device Manager
BIOS setting for integrated GPU cannot be accessed
kbArticles.cause: Integrated GPU on SP-MB-15X may be disabled in BIOS or hardware fault on GPU die.
resolution: Access BIOS and check Graphics Mode setting
Switch from Discrete-Only to Auto/Optimus mode
Update graphics driver for integrated GPU
If integrated GPU does not appear even in BIOS, SP-MB-15X hardware fault
Escalate to Tier 2 — motherboard GPU die failure is non-repairable without board replacement

kbArticles.title: Motherboard POST LED Error Code Reference for AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Agent needs LED blink code reference
kbArticles.cause: Reference article for LED POST diagnostic codes on AV-LP-15X-PRO platform.
resolution: 1 blink: POST in progress — normal
2 blinks: BIOS recovery mode
3 blinks: RAM error — reseat SP-RAM-16-DDR5
4 blinks: Thermal error — check SP-FAN-15X
5 blinks: CPU/Motherboard fault — escalate Tier 2
6 blinks: Display failure — check SP-DISP-15X-FHD
Rapid continuous blinks: Power fault — check SP-CHG-65W and SP-BATT-15X

kbArticles.title: Motherboard Failure After Liquid Damage on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: System stopped working after liquid spill
kbArticles.cause: Liquid damage to SP-MB-15X motherboard causing corrosion and short circuits.
resolution: Power off immediately — do not attempt to power on
Document liquid damage for claim assessment
Standard warranty does not cover liquid damage
Assess accidental damage plan coverage
If no coverage, provide out-of-warranty quote for SP-MB-15X replacement
Order SP-MB-15X from WH-SJO-002 (San Jose Spare Parts & Warranty Depot)

kbArticles.title: Thunderbolt Port Not Working on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Thunderbolt controller missing in Device Manager
AeroVolt Nexus Docking Station connects via USB only, not Thunderbolt
kbArticles.cause: Thunderbolt controller firmware outdated or Thunderbolt driver missing. Rarely SP-MB-15X hardware fault.
resolution: Install latest Thunderbolt driver from support portal
Update Thunderbolt controller firmware
Enable Thunderbolt in BIOS if disabled
Authorize Thunderbolt connection when prompted
If Thunderbolt controller absent in Device Manager after driver install, SP-MB-15X fault — escalate

kbArticles.title: HDMI Port No Output on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: HDMI connected to TV or monitor but no signal
External display detected in OS settings but black screen
kbArticles.cause: HDMI controller driver issue, HDMI port physical damage, or GPU output configuration.
resolution: Update display driver
Try different HDMI cable and monitor
Cycle display output using Fn+F8 or Windows+P
Inspect HDMI port for bent pins
If port is physically damaged, SP-MB-15X replacement may be needed

kbArticles.title: Ethernet Port Not Working on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Ethernet cable connected but no network
LAN adapter missing in Device Manager
Network lights on port not illuminated
kbArticles.cause: LAN driver missing or LAN controller on SP-MB-15X has failed.
resolution: Install LAN driver from support portal
Check Device Manager for Ethernet adapter
Test with different Ethernet cable and switch port
Update BIOS for LAN controller fixes
If LAN controller absent in Device Manager after driver install, SP-MB-15X fault

kbArticles.title: POST Takes Too Long on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: Logo screen hangs before OS loads
Boot time significantly longer than before
kbArticles.cause: BIOS memory training, SSD detection issue, or USB device connected during boot causing delays.
resolution: Remove all USB devices and retry
Enable Fast Boot in BIOS
Run SP-SSD-1TB-NVME diagnostics — slow SSD detection can delay POST
Reseat SP-RAM-16-DDR5 — memory retraining after unseating causes delays
If POST hangs are progressive, check SP-MB-15X for hardware degradation

kbArticles.title: Audio Not Working on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Audio device missing in Device Manager
kbArticles.cause: Audio driver missing after OS reinstall. Rarely, audio codec failure on SP-MB-15X.
resolution: Install audio driver from support portal
Check Device Manager for audio device
Verify audio output device is set correctly in OS
Update BIOS for audio controller support
If audio device absent after driver install, SP-MB-15X audio codec fault — escalate

kbArticles.title: SP-MB-15X Shipping and Handling Protocols
kbArticles.cause: Reference article for SP-MB-15X motherboard shipping and handling requirements.
resolution: SP-MB-15X must be shipped in anti-static packaging
Include all original mounting hardware
Do not ship with battery or SSD installed — ship bare board only
Ship from WH-SJO-002 (San Jose Spare Parts & Warranty Depot) — sole stock location for SP-MB-15X (10 units on hand)
For EU customers, escalate to warehouse coordinator for international transfer from WH-SJO-002
Expedited shipping required for warranty replacements — standard processing 1-2 business days from WH-SJO-002 (San Jose Spare Parts & Warranty Depot)
Include RMA number on packaging

kbArticles.title: BIOS Version Check Procedure on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Agent needs to verify current BIOS version
Customer asking about BIOS update status
kbArticles.cause: Reference article for checking BIOS version on AV-LP-13A-STRAT.
resolution: Method 1: Press F2 during POST to enter BIOS — version displayed on main page
Method 2: In OS, run 'msinfo32' → System Summary → BIOS Version/Date
Method 3: In OS terminal, run 'wmic bios get smbiosbiosversion'
Compare version against latest on support portal
If outdated, download and apply update with SP-CHG-65W connected

kbArticles.title: Motherboard Under Warranty Replacement on AeroVolt A5X Pro
kbArticles.cause: Warranty-covered SP-MB-15X failure requiring replacement.
resolution: Verify warranty status and get Tier 2 approval code
Open replacement order in case management system
Source SP-MB-15X from WH-SJO-002 (San Jose Spare Parts & Warranty Depot)
Arrange dispatch to service center or technician
Customer data protection: advise backup before service
Close case with approval code and tracking reference

kbArticles.title: SD Card Slot Not Reading on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: SD card inserted but not recognized
SD card reader missing in Device Manager
Works on external USB card reader
kbArticles.cause: SD card reader controller on SP-MB-15X has failed or driver is missing.
resolution: Install SD card reader driver from support portal
Test with multiple SD cards to rule out card fault
Check Device Manager for card reader device
Update BIOS
If reader absent from Device Manager after driver install, SP-MB-15X fault — escalate

kbArticles.title: POST Completes But OS Does Not Load on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: OS fails to load — black screen or spinning cursor indefinitely
kbArticles.cause: OS boot loader corruption or SP-SSD-1TB-NVME file system error. Not a motherboard issue.
resolution: Boot from USB recovery media
Run startup repair from OS recovery environment
Run disk check (CHKDSK) on SP-SSD-1TB-NVME
If OS is unrecoverable, reinstall OS
Verify BIOS boot order points to SP-SSD-1TB-NVME

kbArticles.title: SSD Not Detected on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: OS installer says no disks available
kbArticles.cause: SP-SSD-1TB-NVME loose in M.2 slot, corrupted, or M.2 slot failure on SP-MB-15X.
resolution: Reseat SP-SSD-1TB-NVME in M.2 slot — ensure screw is securing SSD
Check BIOS for NVMe device listing
Test with alternate SP-SSD-1TB-NVME if available
Update BIOS for NVMe compatibility improvements
If M.2 slot is faulty, SP-MB-15X replacement required

kbArticles.title: Slow SSD Performance on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: SSD read/write speeds far below rated spec
OS feels sluggish despite high-end CPU
kbArticles.cause: SP-SSD-1TB-NVME running in SATA compatibility mode instead of NVMe, thermal throttling of SSD, or driver issue.
resolution: Verify SSD is running in NVMe mode in BIOS (not SATA/AHCI mode)
Update NVMe driver to Microsoft standard or OEM NVMe driver
Run storage benchmark to confirm throughput
Check SSD temperature — NVMe SSDs throttle above 70°C
Ensure SP-HEAT-15X thermal pad covers M.2 slot area

kbArticles.title: SSD Failure and Data Loss on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: BIOS reports SP-SSD-1TB-NVME in failed state
kbArticles.cause: SP-SSD-1TB-NVME has reached end of life or has experienced sudden failure due to power event or wear.
resolution: Run SSD diagnostics — capture SMART data
If SMART reports reallocated sectors or critical errors — SSD is failing
Advise customer to backup remaining data immediately
Replace SP-SSD-1TB-NVME from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock)
Reinstall OS on new drive
If within warranty, initiate warranty replacement

kbArticles.title: SSD Replacement Procedure on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
kbArticles.cause: Scheduled or warranty SP-SSD-1TB-NVME NVMe SSD replacement.
resolution: Back up customer data before starting
Power off and disconnect SP-CHG-65W and SP-BATT-15X
Remove base panel
Remove M.2 screw securing SP-SSD-1TB-NVME
Carefully remove SSD at 30-degree angle
Insert new SP-SSD-1TB-NVME and secure with screw
Reassemble and boot to BIOS to verify detection
Install OS or restore from backup

kbArticles.title: Full Disk Encryption Prevents SSD Warranty Replacement on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: SSD has BitLocker or full-disk encryption enabled
Recovery key may not be available
kbArticles.cause: Full disk encryption on SP-SSD-1TB-NVME means data is unrecoverable during replacement without recovery key.
resolution: Advise customer to retrieve recovery key before SSD replacement
If encryption key unavailable, data will be lost after replacement — document customer acceptance
Proceed with SP-SSD-1TB-NVME replacement only after customer acknowledges data loss
Post-replacement: install OS fresh on new SP-SSD-1TB-NVME

kbArticles.title: SSD Upgrade Request on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Customer requests storage upgrade from 1TB to 2TB
Current SP-SSD-1TB-NVME running low on capacity
kbArticles.cause: Customer-initiated storage upgrade.
resolution: Note: warranty on customer-installed parts is not covered by OEM
Advise customer to backup data before upgrade
SP-SSD-1TB-NVME is M.2 2280 form factor — customer should match this spec
If customer wants OEM SP-SSD-1TB-NVME replaced with larger OEM unit, this must be processed as paid upgrade
Refer customer to upgrade service if applicable

kbArticles.title: OS Drive Showing in Wrong BIOS Slot on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: BIOS boot list shows multiple NVMe entries
System boots to wrong OS or drive
kbArticles.cause: BIOS boot order misconfiguration after SP-SSD-1TB-NVME reseating or dual-drive configuration.
resolution: Enter BIOS and navigate to Boot Order
Set SP-SSD-1TB-NVME (primary OS drive) as first boot device
Save and exit BIOS
If boot order resets, check for Fast Boot interference
Disable Secure Boot temporarily if needed to identify correct drive

kbArticles.title: Storage Diagnostic Tool Usage for SP-SSD-1TB-NVME
symptoms: Agent needs to run storage diagnostic
kbArticles.cause: Reference article for SSD diagnostics procedure on SP-SSD-1TB-NVME.
resolution: Download AeroVolt Storage Diagnostics from support portal
Boot from diagnostic USB or run from within OS
Select SP-SSD-1TB-NVME as target drive
Run SMART quick test (2 minutes)
Run extended test for intermittent issues (30-60 minutes)
Export diagnostic report and attach to service case
Healthy: proceed with SW troubleshooting. Failed: proceed with replacement from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock)

kbArticles.title: Windows Cannot Be Installed on NVMe on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: OS installer reports 'Cannot install to this disk'
kbArticles.cause: NVMe driver not loaded in OS installer, BIOS in SATA mode, or Secure Boot preventing installation.
resolution: Enable NVMe drivers in OS installer (load driver from USB)
Check BIOS — ensure storage mode is set to NVMe/AHCI
Disable Secure Boot during initial installation
Ensure BIOS is in UEFI mode (not Legacy)
Re-run installation after configuration changes

kbArticles.title: SSD Warranty Replacement from WH-AUS-001
kbArticles.cause: Warranty-covered SP-SSD-1TB-NVME failure.
resolution: Confirm unit warranty status
Log SSD diagnostic report to case
Order SP-SSD-1TB-NVME from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock)
For EU customers, escalate to warehouse coordinator for transfer from WH-AUS-001
Dispatch replacement within 1 business day per SLA
Provide tracking to customer and update case

kbArticles.title: SSD Read Speed Drops After Windows Update on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: SSD performance degraded after a Windows update
Sequential read speeds dropped from 3500 MB/s to 800 MB/s
BIOS shows SSD as NVMe but performance is SATA-level
kbArticles.cause: Windows update replaced optimized NVMe driver with generic Microsoft AHCI driver.
resolution: Check driver in Device Manager — look for 'Standard SATA AHCI Controller' vs NVMe driver
Reinstall OEM NVMe driver from support portal
Restart and rerun benchmark to verify
If issue recurs after Windows update, set NVMe driver update policy to prevent rollback

kbArticles.title: SSD Filling Up Causing OS Slowdown on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Applications crash with 'out of disk space' errors
kbArticles.cause: SP-SSD-1TB-NVME storage full causing OS virtual memory and temp file operations to fail.
resolution: Run Disk Cleanup to remove temp files
Empty Recycle Bin
Identify large files using disk analysis tool
Move data to external storage
Disable hibernation to recover hiberfil.sys space
If customer consistently needs more space, discuss storage upgrade options

kbArticles.title: SSD Part Number Verification for WH Inventory
symptoms: Agent needs to verify SP-SSD-1TB-NVME stock before placing order
kbArticles.cause: Reference article for SP-SSD-1TB-NVME inventory check across warehouse locations.
resolution: Primary stock: WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock) — 120 units on hand
Part code: SP-SSD-1TB-NVME — compatible with ALL products
Check live inventory before placing order
If out of stock, escalate to warehouse coordinator for transfer from another depot

kbArticles.title: BSOD MEMORY_MANAGEMENT on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
kbArticles.cause: Defective or incompatible SP-RAM-16-DDR5 memory module causing memory addressing errors.
resolution: Run Windows Memory Diagnostic or Memtest86 overnight
Reseat SP-RAM-16-DDR5 module
Test with single memory module if dual-channel
Replace SP-RAM-16-DDR5 if errors found in memory test
Order from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock)

kbArticles.title: BSOD BAD_POOL_CALLER on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Crash occurs when opening specific applications
Error dump indicates memory pool corruption
kbArticles.cause: Software driver corrupting memory pool or SP-RAM-16-DDR5 hardware fault.
resolution: Identify recently installed drivers and uninstall
Run Memtest86 to rule out SP-RAM-16-DDR5 hardware fault
Use verifier.exe (Driver Verifier) to identify faulty driver
If memory test fails, replace SP-RAM-16-DDR5
If software-caused, reinstall OS or roll back problematic driver

kbArticles.title: System RAM Not Fully Recognized on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: System shows 8GB usable out of 16GB installed
BIOS shows correct amount but OS reports less
kbArticles.cause: BIOS memory remapping disabled, integrated GPU consuming shared RAM, or SP-RAM-16-DDR5 seating issue.
resolution: Enable memory remapping in BIOS advanced settings
Check BIOS IGPU shared memory allocation — reduce if overly large
Reseat SP-RAM-16-DDR5
Verify OS is 64-bit (32-bit OS limits RAM to 4GB)
If 8GB still showing after BIOS fix, test with alternate SP-RAM-16-DDR5 module

kbArticles.title: RAM Replacement Procedure for AeroVolt ProBook 15X
kbArticles.cause: Approved SP-RAM-16-DDR5 DDR5 RAM module replacement.
resolution: Power off and disconnect SP-CHG-65W and SP-BATT-15X
Open base panel
Locate SO-DIMM slot — release retention clips
Remove old SP-RAM-16-DDR5 at 45-degree angle
Insert new SP-RAM-16-DDR5 at 45 degrees until fully seated
Press down until retention clips lock
Reassemble and boot — verify in BIOS that 16GB is shown

kbArticles.title: BSOD IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: Crash occurs during sleep/wake or hardware operation
Event log references a specific driver
kbArticles.cause: Hardware driver accessing invalid memory address. Often Wi-Fi, GPU, or storage drivers. May also be SP-RAM-16-DDR5 instability.
resolution: Analyze minidump file — identify offending driver
Update or rollback the identified driver
Update all hardware drivers from support portal
Run memory test to rule out SP-RAM-16-DDR5
If memory test fails, replace SP-RAM-16-DDR5 from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock)

kbArticles.title: Random BSOD Without Specific Error Code on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: BSOD occurs randomly, different stop codes each time
kbArticles.cause: SP-RAM-16-DDR5 failing intermittently, causing varied BSOD codes. Multiple random codes strongly indicate RAM hardware issue.
resolution: Run Memtest86 for minimum 4 passes — errors on any pass = faulty RAM
Test single module at a time if dual-channel
Replace SP-RAM-16-DDR5 if errors found
If no memory errors, check SSD health and run temperature stress test
Order SP-RAM-16-DDR5 from WH-AUS-001 if replacement confirmed

kbArticles.title: System Freezes Without BSOD on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: System freezes completely — no response to input
No BSOD — hard freeze requiring power button
kbArticles.cause: SP-RAM-16-DDR5 or SP-SSD-1TB-NVME fault. Thermal issues from SP-FAN-15X can also cause hard freezes.
resolution: Check system temperature during normal use
Run memory diagnostics overnight
Run SSD SMART test
Check event logs for critical errors before freeze events
If no diagnostic errors found, update all drivers and BIOS
Escalate if freezes persist with no diagnostic evidence

kbArticles.title: BSOD PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
kbArticles.cause: Software trying to access invalid memory region. SP-RAM-16-DDR5 errors or corrupt system files.
resolution: Run SFC (System File Checker) to repair corrupt OS files
Run DISM to repair component store
Run memory diagnostic for SP-RAM-16-DDR5
If referencing a driver file, update or rollback that driver
If memory test fails, replace SP-RAM-16-DDR5

kbArticles.title: RAM Not Running at Rated Speed on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: SP-RAM-16-DDR5 rated at 5600MHz but running at 4800MHz
BIOS shows memory at lower speed
kbArticles.cause: XMP/EXPO profile not enabled in BIOS for SP-RAM-16-DDR5.
resolution: Enter BIOS and navigate to Memory settings
Enable XMP or EXPO profile for SP-RAM-16-DDR5
Select the correct profile (XMP Profile 1 for 5600MHz)
Save and reboot — verify speed in BIOS and Task Manager
Note: enabling XMP may affect stability — test with memory diagnostics after enabling

kbArticles.title: RAM Warranty Replacement on AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
kbArticles.cause: Defective SP-RAM-16-DDR5 module confirmed by memory diagnostics.
resolution: Attach Memtest86 error report to case
Verify warranty status
Approve SP-RAM-16-DDR5 replacement
Order from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock)
Dispatch replacement and schedule technician or provide self-install guide
Run memory diagnostic post-replacement to confirm resolution

kbArticles.title: Dual Channel RAM Configuration on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: Customer upgraded to 32GB but system running in single channel
Performance lower than expected after upgrade
kbArticles.cause: Two SP-RAM-16-DDR5 modules installed in same slot pair (both in slot 1) instead of matched slots for dual-channel.
resolution: Power off and open base panel
Ensure one SP-RAM-16-DDR5 module is in Slot A and one in Slot B
Slot labeling typically: DIMM0 + DIMM1 = dual channel pair
Reseat modules in correct paired slots
Boot and verify dual channel in BIOS memory info
Run benchmark to confirm performance improvement

kbArticles.title: BSOD CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED After Windows Update on AeroVolt ProBook 15X
symptoms: Blue screen: CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED after recent Windows update
System crashes within minutes of login
kbArticles.cause: Windows update incompatibility with current driver stack. Unlikely SP-RAM-16-DDR5 hardware issue if Safe Mode works.
resolution: Boot in Safe Mode and uninstall recent Windows update
Roll back problematic update via Windows Update history
Update all drivers before re-applying Windows update
If BSOD persists in Safe Mode, run SP-RAM-16-DDR5 diagnostics
Consider clean OS install if issue is irreparable

kbArticles.title: RAM Module Not Compatible Warning on AeroVolt A5X Pro
symptoms: BIOS warning: 'Memory module may not be compatible'
kbArticles.cause: Non-OEM DDR5 RAM installed — may not be on the BIOS compatibility list. OEM SP-RAM-16-DDR5 is validated.
resolution: Advise customer that non-OEM RAM is not supported under warranty
Recommend reinstalling OEM SP-RAM-16-DDR5
If customer insists on third-party RAM, document and note warranty implications
If OEM SP-RAM-16-DDR5 is needed, source from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock)
Run memory diagnostic to assess stability with current configuration

kbArticles.title: Memory Upgrade Path for AeroVolt Stratos Air 13
symptoms: Customer wants to upgrade from 16GB to 32GB

resolution: AV-LP-13A-STRAT supports maximum of 32GB DDR5 via two SO-DIMM slots

Recommend OEM SP-RAM-16-DDR5 for compatibility

Order SP-RAM-16-DDR5 from WH-AUS-001 (Austin Fulfillment Center - Alpha Dock) for OEM-supported upgrade

kbArticles.title: BSOD SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED on Quantum Apex 17-G
symptoms: BSOD: SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED referencing nvlddmkm.sys or iaStorAC.sys
References NVMe storage or GPU driver
kbArticles.cause: GPU driver or NVMe driver unhandled exception. May be triggered by SP-RAM-16-DDR5 instability during intensive operations.

If referencing iaStorAC.sys — reinstall Intel RST or switch to Microsoft NVMe driver
Run extended Memtest86 test for SP-RAM-16-DDR5
Run SSD SMART extended test on SP-SSD-1TB-NVME
